ov: رجل السلك (الإنجليزية: The Cable Guy) هو فيلم كوميديا سوداء أمريكي أنتج سنة 1996، بطل الفيلم هو ايقونة الكوميديا جيم كاري.
plotEn:
Steven Kovacs is an architect in Seattle. Steven recently proposed to his girlfriend Robin, who rejected his engagement. Steven temporarily separates from her, and moves into a new apartment alone. Steven decides to call a cable technician with a very severe speech disorder named Ernie "Chip" Douglas, to install cable television service in his apartment. Following his best friend Rick's advice, Steven bribes Chip to get free movie channels. Chip agrees to giving Steven free cable, only on one condition; Chip asks that Steven befriends him, and hangs out with him, to which Steven reluctantly agrees and accepts.
Steven and Chip bond, and develop their friendship. One night to visit to the city's central satellite dish, Chip confides to Steven that when he was young, his father was absent and his mother used television as a "babysitter", and Chip turned to television as his one theraputic outlet to deal with his personal problems. Chip is then revealed to be homeless, and living in his repair van. Chip now becoming obsessed with Steven, shows up uninvited to a basketball game that Steven is playing with his friends, and Chip starts to intentionally embarrass himself in front Steven's other friends. Stevens friends, especially Rick, distance themselves from Steve due to Chip's behavior at the basketball game.
